operatingCapabilities.label: Daily reporting
operatingCapabilities.detail: Supervisor field updates feed into engineer-verified daily reports with mandatory sections, photo evidence, and PDF export.

operatingCapabilities.label: Approval workflows
operatingCapabilities.detail: Reports, material requests, documents, invoices, and payments follow predefined approval chains with 24h reminders and 48h escalation.

operatingCapabilities.label: Document control
operatingCapabilities.detail: Each document has metadata, revision history, approval status, superseded warnings, and full-text search.

operatingCapabilities.label: Financial tracking
operatingCapabilities.detail: Manpower costs, material consumption, tool movements, supplier invoices, and payments connect directly to field activity and project P&L.

operatingCapabilities.label: Mobile field use
operatingCapabilities.detail: Phone-first forms with autosave, offline draft storage, photo capture queue, and background sync for construction site conditions.

operatingDomains.description: A guided form captures attendance, overtime, materials consumed, equipment used, safety incidents, WIR status, delays, photos, and attachments. The supervisor provides field input; the engineer verifies work quality and submits the official report. Reports are numbered, locked after approval, and exported as PDF.
operatingDomains.sections: Manpower, equipment, material consumption, safety, WIR/inspection status, delays, next-day plan, photos, attachments

operatingDomains.description: Every report, material request, document, invoice, payment, and scope change routes through role-based approval chains. Approvers are assigned automatically by project and role. The system sends reminders at 24 hours and escalates at 48 hours. Rejection reasons are retained in the record. Approved records are immutable without an audited override.
operatingDomains.sections: Multi-level chains, automatic approver resolution, SLA tracking, delegation, escalation, audit trail

operatingDomains.description: Documents carry metadata including type, project, revision, approval status, and expiry dates. Each upload creates a versioned record with active/superseded state. Field teams always see the approved active version. Managers retain full revision history, superseded warnings, and approval evidence. Full-text search covers document titles and metadata.
operatingDomains.sections: Upload, metadata, approval routing, version history, active/superseded state, full-text search, expiry reminders

operatingDomains.description: Materials and tagged tools are tracked across warehouses and project site stores. Consumables carry on-hand, reserved, and available quantities per location. Asset-tagged tools show current warehouse or site, project assignment, condition, and last movement. Issue and transfer requests require approval before the Store Keeper records movement. Low-stock alerts fire per item and location.
operatingDomains.sections: Multi-location stock, tool current-location tracking, approval-gated movements, low-stock alerts, supplier context, full movement history

businessFlow.title: 1. Project baseline
businessFlow.detail: Create project code, BOQ, milestones, members, and target dates.

businessFlow.title: 2. Site update
businessFlow.detail: Capture attendance, overtime, location, progress, safety, materials, and photos.

businessFlow.title: 3. Technical verification
businessFlow.detail: Validate work quality, WIR status, quantities, blockers, and next-day plan.

businessFlow.title: 4. Approval control
businessFlow.detail: Approve, reject with reason, or trigger escalation based on role and SLA.

businessFlow.title: 5. Company record
businessFlow.detail: Update KPIs, generate PDF, email stakeholders, log audit trail, and refresh documents/costs.
